one_line: Anthropic releases new models and moves toward an IPO, while Nvidia faces investigations and regulatory probes involving chip exports.

themes.title: Anthropic launches new models and IPO plans
themes.text: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, offering faster speeds and open-ended technical capabilities. Meanwhile, the company circulated and then retracted pricing details for an upcoming IPO aiming to raise up to $69 billion.

themes.title: Nvidia CEO investigated amid chip export probe
themes.text: Nvidia's board is investigating CEO Jensen Huang over an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, causing him to withdraw from speaking engagements. Separately, a Commerce Department probe into the diversion of Nvidia chips to China was transferred to the Justice Department after Nvidia intervened.

themes.title: New AI regulations and hardware compliance checks
themes.text: Australia announced plans to establish an AI safety regulator with mandatory breach reporting following an incident involving an OpenAI agent. In China, Moonshot AI signed a contract to rent Nvidia B300 servers in a deal that may breach US export restrictions.

themes.title: Infrastructure expansions and new model releases
themes.text: SpaceX plans a $24 billion gas power plant and super-compute facility in Texas, while Disney and Adobe partnered to build proprietary generative AI models. Other industry updates include new hardware from Google and Meta, a data center breach at Fireworks, and a $130 million funding round for Mavria.
